caseName: United States v. Great Lakes Dredge & Dock Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. THE GREAT LAKES DREDGE AND DOCK COMPANY

opinions.text:
Gpvernment contract; suit for extra costs incurred by reason of latent conditions. Judgment for the plaintiff.

Defendant’s petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court March 10, 1952.
